heading.title: Of Grant of Probate and Letters of Administration

article.title: Procedure where executor renounces or fails to accept within time limited.
article.content: If an executor renounces or fails to accept an executorship within the time limited for the acceptance or refusal thereof, the will may be proved and letters of administration, with a copy of the will annexed, may be granted to the person who would be entitled to administration in case of intestacy.
article.html:
231Procedure where executor renounces or fails to accept within time limited.

Section 231 · Part IX · Chapter I · page 71 of the Act

If an executor renounces or fails to accept an executorship within the time limited for the acceptance or refusal thereof, the will may be proved and letters of administration, with a copy of the will annexed, may be granted to the person who would be entitled to administration in case of intestacy.
